The study uses a hybrid FEM-ANN technique to establish relationships between material design and product design domains.
The authors use artificial neural networks to optimize the development of new alloys with necessitated improvements in properties and chemical mixture.
The study focuses on the ASTM A487 Gr 4C high-pressure application material.
The maximum allowable thickness of the valve body is 5.92 *10^-5 m.
The maximum stress achieved in the regions around the inner walls is 4.3302*10^8 Pascal.
The minimum life of the casting design is 2116.1 cycles.
The number of hidden layers used in the ANN model is 2.
The number of hidden neurons used in the ANN model is 10 for layer 1 and 5 for layer 2.
The type of network used in this study is a feed-forward back propagation network.
The type of transfer functions used in the ANN model are tansig and log sig for layer 1, and purelin for layer 2.
The performance goal for the network is zero.
The type of training function used in the ANN model is traingdm.
The type of adaption learning function used in the ANN model is learngdm.
The study uses computational fluid dynamics and finite element analysis to validate the results.
The ANN model is trained using a dataset of 95 experimental data points.
The ANN model is tested using a dataset of 40 experimental data points.
The ANN model is validated using a dataset of 11 experimental data points.
